quests.question: Full of swollen phrases and grand promises, the speech was _____ and empty.
quests.explanation: Swollen phrases and grand promises with nothing behind them are pompous: bombastic.

quests.question: She hates losing at cards, board games and even races to the lift; she is very _____.
quests.explanation: Hating to lose even a race to the lift shows a strong drive to win: competitive.

quests.question: The lecture was all monotone slides with no examples, and half the room yawned; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Monotone slides, no examples and yawning listeners show a boring talk, so dull fits.

quests.question: She walked fast with her arms swinging, keeping a _____ pace to stay warm.
quests.explanation: Walking fast with swinging arms to stay warm describes a quick, lively pace: brisk.

quests.question: The film followed every predictable beat and offered no surprise; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Following every predictable beat with no surprise shows dull, unimaginative work: pedestrian.

quests.question: Prices jumped on Monday, crashed on Tuesday and surged again on Wednesday; the market is _____.
quests.explanation: Prices that jump, crash and surge within days are unstable, so volatile fits; stable contradicts.

quests.question: The invitation said 'jeans fine, no speeches, just come'; the dinner will be _____.
quests.explanation: 'Jeans fine, no speeches' shows a relaxed occasion with no strict rules, so informal fits.

quests.question: No snow, no scorching sun and no wind; the weather was _____ all week.
quests.explanation: No snow, no scorching sun and no wind means no extremes, so mild fits; extreme contradicts.

quests.question: Through years of rejections, Hana held _____ to her goal.
quests.explanation: Holding to a goal through years of rejection shows firm loyalty to it, so steadfastly fits.

quests.question: Her calm, well-reasoned speech changed three sceptics' minds; she is highly _____.
quests.explanation: Changing three sceptics' minds with a reasoned speech shows she wins people over: persuasive.

quests.question: One week she loved the plan; the next she hated it, with no reason; her moods are _____.
quests.explanation: Swinging from love to hate with no reason shows unpredictable changes of mind: capricious.

quests.question: Trembling at the edge of the diving board, Ina was _____ to jump.
quests.explanation: Trembling at the edge of a diving board shows fear, so afraid fits; eager and willing contradict.

quests.question: Juice ran down my chin as I bit into the peach, which was perfectly _____.
quests.explanation: Juice running down my chin shows the peach was full of liquid, so juicy fits; dry contradicts.

quests.question: The book was written by a leading expert and cited by courts; it is a highly _____ source.
quests.explanation: A leading expert's work cited by courts is trusted and reliable, so authoritative fits.

quests.question: Tom broke the vase, stared at the floor and whispered an apology; he felt truly _____.
quests.explanation: Whispering an apology while staring at the floor shows regret, so sorry fits; proud contradicts.

quests.question: She campaigned for ten years, door to door, never tiring or giving up; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Ten years of door-to-door work without tiring shows endless energy: indefatigable.

quests.question: A cool breeze, soft music and friendly waiters made the evening _____.
quests.explanation: A cool breeze, soft music and friendly waiters all add comfort, so pleasant fits.

quests.question: She skipped the jargon and explained the contract _____ so that everyone could follow.
quests.explanation: Skipping jargon so that everyone could follow means speaking simply and clearly: plainly.

quests.question: He cracked jokes at the solemn ceremony and mocked the speaker; his humour was _____.
quests.explanation: Joking at a solemn event and mocking the speaker shows disrespect, so irreverent fits.

quests.question: The new towel was soft and light as a cloud and felt wonderfully _____.
quests.explanation: 'Soft and light as a cloud' describes a towel that is fluffy; rough and scratchy contradict it.

quests.question: He fixes bikes, laptops and radios in minutes; he is _____ at repairs.
quests.explanation: Fixing bikes, laptops and radios in minutes shows great skill, so adept fits; hopeless contradicts.

quests.question: After costs, the shop earned £50,000 in a year; the business was _____.
quests.explanation: Earning £50,000 after costs means money made, so profitable fits; loss-making contradicts.

quests.question: The hosts opened the door with hugs and a warm meal; the family seemed _____.
quests.explanation: Hugs at the door and a warm meal show a friendly greeting, so welcoming fits; hostile contradicts.

quests.question: As alarms blared and the engines shook, the captain stayed _____, sipping his tea.
quests.explanation: Sipping tea while alarms blare shows he could not be upset, which is imperturbable.

quests.question: The teacher followed the plan to the minute and refused every change, clinging _____ to it.
quests.explanation: Following a plan to the minute and refusing every change means holding on stiffly: rigidly.

quests.question: I couldn't see the road ten metres ahead through the _____ fog.
quests.explanation: Not seeing the road ten metres ahead means the fog was dense, so thick fits; thin contradicts.

quests.question: Told his flight was cancelled, he strolled off whistling, quite _____.
quests.explanation: Strolling off whistling after a cancellation shows a carefree lack of worry, so insouciant fits; anxious contradicts.

quests.question: Though the crowd was shouting, the negotiator replied _____, keeping her voice level.
quests.explanation: Keeping her voice level amid shouting shows calm detachment, so coolly fits; hotly contradicts.

quests.question: His report was a plain list of figures with no imagery or flair; his style is _____.
quests.explanation: A plain list with no imagery or flair is dull and matter-of-fact, which is prosaic.

quests.question: He told her, without softening a word, that her idea wouldn't work, speaking _____.
quests.explanation: 'Without softening a word' shows he spoke harshly and directly, so bluntly fits; gently contradicts.
